notes.title: Newest Version (1.08) Available on MacOS
notes.notes:
Should be compatible with Apple Silicon! 

Let me know how it works, I don't have a Mac to test with.

notes.title: 1.08a Hotfix Patch
notes.notes:
-Fixed bug with move undo not refunding hydrogen if you select another unit first
-Fixed bug with center cell not alerting for no hydrogen when selecting a unit there

notes.title: Patch 1.08 is Live on Windows
notes.notes:
-Fixed bug with Wormhole not allowing a free 2 space move (StarBase, Propulsion Gel) with 0 hydrogen
-Wormhole now costs 6 hydrogen
-Added ability to undo card right-click discards until you make another game action
-Fixed typo in Nova Gate flavor text
-Added ability to undo non-exploring moves
-Added ability to keep playing after game is finished (to see what kind of score you can get)
-Maximum XP requirement for level up reduced from 1000 -> 750

notes.title: Patch 1.07 "Secrets of the Galaxy" is Live on Steam
notes.notes:
Patch notes are here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/655480/discussions/0/2763442118825031511/

This is probably the biggest update I've ever done to any BrainGoodGame :O

Highlights include flavor text for every card, a ton of bug fixes and some card balance/redesign updates!

Enjoy, and thanks for playing Solar Settlers!

(To get info on when we release new BrainGoodGames and large updates for old ones, sign up for the mailing list here: https://braingoodgames.com/email.html)

notes.title: Solar Settlers Patch 1.06 – “Expert Exploration” is Live
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29476418/5faa1d3958ddb65946d2939ad9ef30a5f7aff5da.png

Patch highlights include a new Expert Mode for faster, more difficult games (it unlocks at XP level 10), a bunch of new goal cards for the races, a new base set card to unlock and a ton of bug-fixes and quality of life improvements.

You can read the full patch notes here:
http://blog.braingoodgames.com/2018/08/30/solar-settlers-patch-1-06-expert-exploration-is-live-on-steam/

notes.title: Release Date Moved (Now July 21)
notes.notes:
Edit: Release date is now July 21

---

Just like it says on the tin, Solar Settlers will now be released on July 26th!

If you're a YouTuber/content creator, I would HUGELY appreciate if you extended the video embargo until then!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29476418/d4f7f4accc57eeb403d36d09f745777344bc0a5f.png

Thanks to everybody for your understanding, this is new territory for BrainGoodGames. I'm trying to see this as an opportunity to polish the heck out of the game before release, but mostly I'm attempting not to freak out.
